designations.eng: Relative instrumental spectral function; detected radiant power spectrum

eng: Relative instrumental spectral function; detected radiant power spectrum

terms.designation: Relative instrumental spectral function; detected radiant power spectrum

definitions.content: Function proportional to the product of the relative spectral distribution of the radiant energy, the relative spectral transmittance of all optical parts and the relative spectral sensitivity of the detector.

notes.content: The relative instrumental spectral function generally has different values for each particular wavelength.
